notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Hibru i no tok husat i setim kas — mi putim ⟨em⟩ bilong tok klia; tikina i Yahwe.

notes.subject: שבות
notes.rationale: שבות i save min 'ol prisna / taim bilong prisna' o 'olgeta samting i go bek olsem bipo' — YLT 'turning back' vs KJV 'turned the captivity'.

notes.subject: kas bilong yu
notes.rationale: Kas i ken min kas gutpela ( Gutpela samting bilong Yuda ) o kas bilong kot — Hosia 6:11 wantaim 7:1–2 i soim kot, olsem na kas bilong kot i strongpela moa.

translation: Tu, Yuda, ⟨em⟩ i setim kas bilong yu, taim mi bringim bek ol prisna bilong ol man bilong mi.
